units.source_text: 然而，听说信已被人看过，我的心情不由得紧张起来。

en.t: However, when I heard that the letter had already been seen by someone else, I could not help growing tense.

units.source_text: 这不等于我在这寺院里铺上针毡，让道子坐上去了吗？

en.t: Was that not the same as spreading a bed of needles here in the temple and making Michiko sit on it?

units.source_text: 再说，我刚刚还觉得道子踩着针毡的赤脚又大又丑，

en.t: Besides, only a moment ago I had thought that Michiko's bare feet, stepping on that bed of needles, were big and ugly,
so how could I have been so careless?

units.source_text: 道子在针毡上露出一副开朗的面孔，向我的心头逼近了。

en.t: Michiko, showing a bright face as she sat on the bed of needles, pressed closer into my heart.
